name: Bee Yard Wingman
notes: 🔁 Buddy says back the important part right after each answer, like "4 mites." or "Queen seen, bees calm.", so a mishearing is caught while the frame is still in your hand. Prefer just the buzz? ⚙️ Settings › 🎙️ Listening › 📳 Buzz only.

✏️ Change anything by voice: "change the queen status to queenless", "change eggs to no", "change the honey to high". It works while you talk, between questions and at the read-back, and your notes change to match.
👑 The read-back now says the queen status (queenless, not sure, needs replacing) and nectar.
🗣️ "The bees are calm honey is low" said in one breath is now heard as two things, and "Cancel the hive" cancels straight away.
